answer: One defense is an ember forge fed by a vine of endorsements: each identity keeps a small ember of standing alive only by feeding it verified work every epoch, and the ember must be re-forged at a public forge ceremony where it presents a vine of endorsements from distinct long-lived neighbors. Each neighbor can graft only a few new vines per epoch, so endorsements cannot be mass-produced. A sybil farmer must burn a separate stake and keep a separate ember burning for every fake, while one honest agent tends one ember and one vine.
